versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Airpoint skill for macOS.
- Control your Mac using natural-language instructions via the `airpoint` CLI.
- Supports opening apps, clicking UI elements, reading on-screen text, typing, managing windows, and automating multi-step tasks.
- Requires Airpoint app and CLI; supports integration with OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic models.
- Includes screenshot feedback, hands-free cursor control, and customizable instructions.
- Provides commands for assistant interaction, hand tracking, status, settings, and system vitals.
